s_py: wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng nǐ ma
zh: 我喜欢游泳，你呢？
py: wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng nǐ ne
en: I like swimming. And you?
why: 'And you?' bouncing the question back is pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement before it, not a bare 你.

s: 放心，我们这次一定会赢的。
s_py: fàng xīn wǒ men zhè cì yī dìng huì yíng de
zh: 放心，我们这次一定会赢的。
py: fàng xīn wǒ men zhè cì yī dìng huì yíng de
en: Don't worry, we will definitely win this time.
why: 会...的 is the standard assurance about the future. It looks like it needs 了 after 赢, but 的 is correct here.

s_py: nǐ men tī de zhēn hǎo ma
zh: 你们踢得真好啊！
py: nǐ men tī de zhēn hǎo a
en: You all play so well!
why: 真好 is an exclamation, and 吗 would make it a yes/no question. The warm particle is 啊.

q: 别关灯，球场上还有人在练球___。
zh: 别关灯，球场上还有人在练球呢。
py: bié guān dēng qiú chǎng shàng hái yǒu rén zài liàn qiú ne
en: Don't turn off the lights; there are still people practising on the pitch.
why: 还 + 在 + verb shows an ongoing state, and 呢 points it out to a listener who may not realise. 吗 would ask instead of inform.

q: 请问，地铁站在哪儿___？
zh: 请问，地铁站在哪儿？
py: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zài nǎ r
en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?
why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 must not be added. 吗 only turns a statement into a yes/no question.

q: 这么大的雨，比赛应该会推迟___。
zh: 这么大的雨，比赛应该会推迟吧。
py: zhè me dà de yǔ bǐ sài yīng gāi huì tuī chí ba
en: With rain this heavy, the match will probably be postponed, I suppose.
why: 应该 expresses a presumption, and 吧 marks it as a guess open to confirmation. 嘛 would claim it is obvious, and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 你放心，他会来___。
zh: 你放心，他会来的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn tā huì lái de
en: Don't worry, he will come.
why: 会...的 is a promise about the future after 放心. 了 would say he has now started coming, which does not reassure.

q: 你大概是第一次来这个球场___？
zh: 你大概是第一次来这个球场吧？
py: nǐ dà gài shì dì yī cì lái zhè ge qiú chǎng ba
en: I'd guess this is your first time at this pitch, right?
why: 大概 marks a guess that invites confirmation, so 吧. 吗 would ask a neutral question and sounds odd after 大概.

s: 现在才九点，商店还没开门呢。
s_py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén ne
zh: 现在才九点，商店还没开门呢。
py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén ne
en: It's only nine o'clock; the shops haven't opened yet.
why: 才 and 还没 both describe a situation that has not changed, so 呢 is right. It looks odd without 了, but 还没 never takes 了.

q: 路灯都亮___，我们该回家了。
zh: 路灯都亮了，我们该回家了。
py: lù dēng dōu liàng le wǒ men gāi huí jiā le
en: The street lamps have all come on; we should go home.
why: 亮了 reports that the lights have just come on, a change. 吗 would ask a question and 的 would be an assurance.

q: 你别催，我正在查去机场的路线___，马上就好。
zh: 你别催，我正在查去机场的路线呢，马上就好。
py: nǐ bié cuī wǒ zhèng zài chá qù jī chǎng de lù xiàn ne mǎ shàng jiù hǎo
en: Stop rushing me; I'm checking the route to the airport and it'll be done in a moment.
why: 正在 + verb is a progressive action, and 呢 tells the listener it is going on right now. 吗 would turn the sentence into a question.

zh: 这座城市的夜景多漂亮啊！
py: zhè zuò chéng shì de yè jǐng duō piào liàng a
en: How beautiful the night view of this city is!
why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation, so 多 comes before 漂亮 and 啊 closes the sentence.

q: 请问，去博物馆要换几次车___？
zh: 请问，去博物馆要换几次车？
py: qǐng wèn qù bó wù guǎn yào huàn jǐ cì chē
en: Excuse me, how many times do I change to get to the museum?
why: 几次 is a question word asking for a number, so the sentence is already a question and 吗 is wrong.

q: 他的网球打得这么好，以前一定学过___？
zh: 他的网球打得这么好，以前一定学过吧？
py: tā de wǎng qiú dǎ de zhè me hǎo yǐ qián yī dìng xué guò ba
en: He plays tennis so well; he must have learned before, right?
why: 一定 plus a conclusion from evidence calls for 吧, seeking agreement. 吗 would not fit a speaker who is already convinced.

s_py: tā shàng gè yuè méi lái le
zh: 他上个月没来。
py: tā shàng gè yuè méi lái
en: He didn't come last month.
why: 没 already says it did not happen in the past, so 了 cannot be added. A plain past negative takes only 没.

s_py: nǐ bù xiǎng qù jiù bié qù bei
zh: 你不想去就别去呗。
py: nǐ bù xiǎng qù jiù bié qù bei
en: If you don't want to go, then don't.
why: ...就...呗 is a casual 'then just don't' shrug. It looks like it lacks a verb after 就, but 别去 is the verb.

s_py: tā wèi shén me méi lái bǐ sài ne
zh: 他为什么没来比赛呢？
py: tā wèi shén me méi lái bǐ sài ne
en: Why didn't he come to the match, I wonder?
why: 呢 can soften a question that already has a question word. It is optional but correct, while 吗 would be wrong here.

zh: 我们明天去爬山吧。
py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān ba
en: Let's go hiking tomorrow.
why: 吧 ends the suggestion. The time word 明天 can come before or after 我们, but both stay before the verb.

q: 地铁快进站___，请站在黄线后面。
zh: 地铁快进站了，请站在黄线后面。
py: dì tiě kuài jìn zhàn le qǐng zhàn zài huáng xiàn hòu miàn
en: The train is about to arrive; please stand behind the yellow line.
why: 快...了 says something is about to happen, a new situation. 吗 would ask, and 吧 would soften it into a guess.

task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你想去公园吗？
py: nǐ xiǎng qù gōng yuán ma
en: Do you want to go to the park?
why: 吗 goes at the very end of the statement; nothing else moves.

s: 路太远了，我们打车去吧吗。
s_py: lù tài yuǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba ma
zh: 路太远了，我们打车去吧。
py: lù tài yuǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba
en: The way is too far; let's take a taxi.
why: 吧 and 吗 never combine. A suggestion takes 吧 alone.

s_py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ le
zh: 比赛还没开始呢。
py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ ne
en: The match hasn't started yet.
why: 还没 describes an unchanged situation, so 了 is impossible. The right particle is 呢.

q: 他们为什么不来参加这次马拉松比赛___？
zh: 他们为什么不来参加这次马拉松比赛？
py: tā men wèi shén me bù lái cān jiā zhè cì mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài
en: Why aren't they coming to this marathon?
why: 为什么 asks for a reason, so the sentence is already a question. Adding 吗 gives a wh-word plus a yes/no marker, which is wrong.

s_py: nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shì qí chē ma
zh: 你坐地铁还是骑车？
py: nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shì qí chē
en: Are you taking the subway or riding a bike?
why: 还是 already asks the listener to choose, so the sentence is a question and 吗 cannot be added.

q: 这条路可以骑自行车___？
zh: 这条路可以骑自行车吗？
py: zhè tiáo lù kě yǐ qí zì xíng chē ma
en: Can you ride a bike on this road?
why: A neutral yes/no question with no guess behind it takes 吗. 吧 would mean 'I suppose you can, right?', and 呢 cannot make a statement a question.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ma
zh: 你想吃点什么吗？
py: nǐ xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ma
en: Would you like something to eat?
why: Here 什么 means 'something', not 'what', so the sentence is a yes/no question and 吗 is correct. It looks wrong because of 什么.

q: 我现在不想去爬山___。
zh: 我现在不想去爬山了。
py: wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng qù pá shān le
en: I don't want to go hiking any more.
why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'not any more', a change from before. 呢 would say the opposite, that I still do not want to.

q: 下雨___，今天不踢球了。
zh: 下雨了，今天不踢球了。
py: xià yǔ le jīn tiān bù tī qiú le
en: It's started raining, so no football today.
why: 下雨了 reports a new situation: it was dry before and is raining now. 吗 would ask a question and 的 would promise future rain.

q: 外面下着大雨___，别去跑步了。
zh: 外面下着大雨呢，别去跑步了。
py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ ne bié qù pǎo bù le
en: It's pouring outside; don't go running.
why: 着 describes a state that is still going on, and 呢 stresses that it is the case right now. 吗 would turn the warning into a question.

q: 他现在当上足球队的队长___。
zh: 他现在当上足球队的队长了。
py: tā xiàn zài dāng shàng zú qiú duì de duì zhǎng le
en: He has become the football team's captain now.
why: 当上 + 现在 reports a new status, and 了 marks it as new. 呢 would say he is still in the process of something.

s: 这条街以前很安静，现在热闹了。
s_py: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián hěn ān jìng xiàn zài rè nào le
zh: 这条街以前很安静，现在热闹了。
py: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián hěn ān jìng xiàn zài rè nào le
en: This street used to be quiet, but now it's lively.
why: 现在 + adjective + 了 reports a change from 以前. It looks like the adjective should take 很, but 了 already marks the new state.

q: 别灰心，这次输了，下次你们一定会赢___。
zh: 别灰心，这次输了，下次你们一定会赢的。
py: bié huī xīn zhè cì shū le xià cì nǐ men yī dìng huì yíng de
en: Don't lose heart; you lost this time, but you will definitely win next time.
why: 一定会...的 comforts the listener with certainty about the future. 吧 would make it a guess and 了 would report a change.

q: 来，我们一起打羽毛球___。
zh: 来，我们一起打羽毛球吧。
py: lái wǒ men yì qǐ dǎ yǔ máo qiú ba
en: Come on, let's play badminton together.
why: 来 plus 我们一起 is an invitation, and 吧 makes it a suggestion. 吗 would turn it into a question and 了 is wrong for an invitation.

q: 别担心，明天不会下雨___。
zh: 别担心，明天不会下雨的。
py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bú huì xià yǔ de
en: Don't worry, it won't rain tomorrow.
why: 不会...的 is a calm reassurance about the future. 了 reports a change that has happened, and 吗 would ask a question instead of reassuring.

q: 我保证，我不会迟到___。
zh: 我保证，我不会迟到的。
py: wǒ bǎo zhèng wǒ bú huì chí dào de
en: I promise I won't be late.
why: 保证 plus 不会...的 is a firm promise. 吧 would soften it into a guess, and 吗 would ask a question.

zh: 他在操场打篮球呢。
py: tā zài cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú ne
en: He's playing basketball on the sports ground right now.
why: 在 + verb with 呢 at the end shows an action in progress. 呢 closes the sentence and cannot go earlier.

q: 别进去，他们在打球___。
zh: 别进去，他们在打球呢。
py: bié jìn qù tā men zài dǎ qiú ne
en: Don't go in; they're playing ball.
why: 在 + verb marks an action in progress, and the sentence-final 呢 says 'it is happening right now'. 吗 would turn it into a question.

s: 他还是个孩子嘛，别骂他。
s_py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié mà tā
zh: 他还是个孩子嘛，别骂他。
py: tā hái shì gè hái zi ma bié mà tā
en: He's still a child, after all; don't scold him.
why: 嘛 says the reason is obvious and never asks. It sounds like 吗 but here it is the right particle.

q: 我们怎么去体育馆___？
zh: 我们怎么去体育馆呢？
py: wǒ men zěn me qù tǐ yù guǎn ne
en: So how are we getting to the gym?
why: 怎么 makes this a question, so 吗 is impossible. 呢 is the particle that softens a question-word question and sounds like 'so, how?'.

q: 我喜欢跑步，你___？
zh: 我喜欢跑步，你呢？
py: wǒ xǐ huān pǎo bù nǐ ne
en: I like running. And you?
why: Bouncing the same question back after a statement is pronoun + 呢. 吗 needs a full statement before it, not a bare 你.

s_py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì lái le
zh: 别担心，他一定会来的。
py: bié dān xīn tā yī dìng huì lái de
en: Don't worry, he'll definitely come.
why: Reassurance about the future is 会...的. 了 reports a change that has happened and does not fit 一定会.

q: 你踢得真好___！
zh: 你踢得真好啊！
py: nǐ tī de zhēn hǎo a
en: You play so well!
why: An admiring exclamation with 真 takes 啊. 吗 would ask a question, and the warm praise would be lost.

q: 只要多练习，你一定会进步___。
zh: 只要多练习，你一定会进步的。
py: zhǐ yào duō liàn xí nǐ yī dìng huì jìn bù de
en: As long as you practise more, you will certainly improve.
why: 一定会...的 gives a confident assurance. 吗 would turn the promise into a question and 呢 does not mean 'for sure'.

src_py: wǒ men méi dào tǐ yù guǎn
task: Say it has not happened yet, with 还没.
zh: 我们还没到体育馆呢。
py: wǒ men hái méi dào tǐ yù guǎn ne
en: We haven't got to the gym yet.
why: 还没 means 'not yet' and takes 呢, never 了, at the end.

s_py: wǒ cái bù qù pǎo bù ma
zh: 我才不去跑步呢！
py: wǒ cái bù qù pǎo bù ne
en: I'm certainly not going running!
why: 才不 + verb + 呢 is a forceful refusal. 吗 would make a question, which clashes with the exclamation.

q: 时间不早了，我们回家___。
zh: 时间不早了，我们回家吧。
py: shí jiān bù zǎo le wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: It's getting late; let's go home.
why: 'Let's...' is a suggestion, which is 吧. 吗 would ask whether we are going home rather than propose it.

q: 今天我没空，明天___？
zh: 今天我没空，明天呢？
py: jīn tiān wǒ méi kòng míng tiān ne
en: I'm busy today. How about tomorrow?
why: 'What about X?' after a previous statement is noun + 呢. 吗 would need a complete clause such as 明天你有空吗.

q: 我本来想睡懒觉，但好___，周六早上八点体育馆门口见。
zh: 我本来想睡懒觉，但好吧，周六早上八点体育馆门口见。
py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng shuì lǎn jiào dàn hǎo ba zhōu liù zǎo shàng bā diǎn tǐ yù guǎn mén kǒu jiàn
en: I wanted to sleep in, but all right then; see you at the gym entrance at eight on Saturday.
why: 好吧 means 'all right then', giving in reluctantly. 好吗 would ask whether it is fine, and 好呢 means nothing here.

q: 骑车穿过老城区，那种感觉多自由___！
zh: 骑车穿过老城区，那种感觉多自由啊！
py: qí chē chuān guò lǎo chéng qū nà zhǒng gǎn jué duō zì yóu a
en: Cycling through the old town, what a free feeling!
why: 多 + adjective is an exclamation, so 啊. 吗 would turn the feeling into a question and 的 is not an exclamation particle.

q: 不会游泳就去学___，现在开始也不晚。
zh: 不会游泳就去学呗，现在开始也不晚。
py: bú huì yóu yǒng jiù qù xué bei xiàn zài kāi shǐ yě bù wǎn
en: If you can't swim, then go and learn; it's not too late to start now.
why: 不会...就学 + 呗 treats the fix as the obvious thing to do. 吗 would ask, and 的 gives a promise rather than advice.

q: 今天的天气多好___！
zh: 今天的天气多好啊！
py: jīn tiān de tiān qì duō hǎo a
en: What lovely weather today!
why: 多 + adjective is exclamatory, and 啊 gives the warmth. 吗 turns it into a question and 了 wrongly implies a change.

q: 你应该是新来的教练___？
zh: 你应该是新来的教练吧？
py: nǐ yīng gāi shì xīn lái de jiào liàn ba
en: You must be the new coach, right?
why: 应该 shows the speaker is guessing and wants confirmation, which is 吧. 吗 would be a neutral question with no guess.

q: 我还没找到那个体育馆___。
zh: 我还没找到那个体育馆呢。
py: wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào nà ge tǐ yù guǎn ne
en: I still haven't found that gym.
why: 还没 describes a situation that has not changed, which is 呢. 了 signals a new situation and cannot follow 没.

q: 你喜欢打篮球___？
zh: 你喜欢打篮球吗？
py: nǐ xǐ huān dǎ lán qiú ma
en: Do you like playing basketball?
why: A plain statement becomes a neutral yes/no question with 吗. 呢 needs a noun or an existing question word, and 吧 would mean the speaker already guesses yes.

zh: 你放心，他一定会来的。
py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì lái de
en: Don't worry, he'll definitely come.
why: 一定会...的 frames the assurance: 的 stays at the very end, with 会 before the verb. 你放心 may open or close the sentence.

q: 没有球拍就借___，别不好意思。
zh: 没有球拍就借呗，别不好意思。
py: méi yǒu qiú pāi jiù jiè bei bié bù hǎo yì sī
en: If you don't have a racket, just borrow one; don't be shy.
why: 没有...就借 + 呗 says the solution is simple. 吗 would ask a question, and 了 would claim the borrowing is done.

s_py: nǐ zuó tiān qù kàn qiú sài le ba
zh: 你昨天去看球赛了吧？
py: nǐ zuó tiān qù kàn qiú sài le ba
en: You went to watch the match yesterday, didn't you?
why: 吧 on a statement is a presumption seeking agreement, and 了 here is the normal verb-了. It looks like a double particle but is fine.

q: 比赛输了也没关系，下次再来___。
zh: 比赛输了也没关系，下次再来呗。
py: bǐ sài shū le yě méi guān xì xià cì zài lái bei
en: Losing the match doesn't matter; just come back next time.
why: 下次再来呗 says 'so what, just try again', a shrug. 吗 would ask whether we come back, and 的 would promise it.

q: 你想去就去___，不用问我。
zh: 你想去就去呗，不用问我。
py: nǐ xiǎng qù jiù qù bei bù yòng wèn wǒ
en: If you want to go, just go; no need to ask me.
why: ...就...呗 means 'then just do it', shrugging off the need to ask. 吗 would turn the sentence into a question.

q: 你去过那家羽毛球馆___？
zh: 你去过那家羽毛球馆吗？
py: nǐ qù guò nà jiā yǔ máo qiú guǎn ma
en: Have you ever been to that badminton hall?
why: The speaker has no opinion and asks for plain information, so 吗. 吧 would suggest the speaker expects yes, and 呢 cannot turn a statement into a question.

q: 比赛还没开始___。
zh: 比赛还没开始呢。
py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ ne
en: The match hasn't started yet.
why: 还没 means nothing has changed yet, so 了 is impossible. 呢 marks 'still the case'.

src_py: wǒ zài dì tiě zhàn nǐ zài nǎ r
task: Shorten the second part to 'And you?'
zh: 我在地铁站，你呢？
py: wǒ zài dì tiě zhàn nǐ ne
en: I'm at the subway station. And you?
why: Pronoun + 呢 bounces the same question back without repeating it.

q: 咱们是坐地铁去还是骑共享单车去___？
zh: 咱们是坐地铁去还是骑共享单车去呢？
py: zán men shì zuò dì tiě qù hái shì qí gòng xiǎng dān chē qù ne
en: So are we going by subway or on shared bikes?
why: 还是 already offers the choice, so 吗 is out. 呢 can sit at the end of such a question to make it sound like thinking aloud.

s_py: nǐ shì jiào liàn ba ma
zh: 你是教练吧？
py: nǐ shì jiào liàn ba
en: You're the coach, right?
why: 吧 and 吗 do not stack. 吧 alone says 'I guess you are, right?'.

q: 你要是累了，就别踢了，回家休息___。
zh: 你要是累了，就别踢了，回家休息吧。
py: nǐ yào shì lèi le jiù bié tī le huí jiā xiū xī ba
en: If you're tired, stop playing and go home to rest.
why: The last clause is gentle advice, which is 吧. 吗 would make the advice a question.

q: 我跑累___，想坐一会儿。
zh: 我跑累了，想坐一会儿。
py: wǒ pǎo lèi le xiǎng zuò yī huì er
en: I'm tired from running now; I want to sit for a bit.
why: 累了 says the speaker has now become tired, which is a change of state. 吗 would ask a question, and 呢 would say it is still going on.

q: 你的脚受伤了，当然不能跑___！
zh: 你的脚受伤了，当然不能跑嘛！
py: nǐ de jiǎo shòu shāng le dàng rán bù néng pǎo ma
en: Your foot is hurt, so of course you can't run!
why: 当然 means 'obviously', which is the job of 嘛. 吗 would turn the statement into a question, which contradicts the exclamation mark.

q: 这个公园真大___！
zh: 这个公园真大啊！
py: zhè ge gōng yuán zhēn dà a
en: This park is so big!
why: 真 + adjective is an exclamation, and 啊 adds warmth. 吗 would turn it into a question, which clashes with the exclamation mark.

src_py: wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
zh: 我们去打羽毛球吧。
py: wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú ba
en: Let's go and play badminton.
why: 吧 at the end turns the plan into a suggestion.

q: 周末的地铁站人真多___！
zh: 周末的地铁站人真多啊！
py: zhōu mò de dì tiě zhàn rén zhēn duō a
en: The subway station is so crowded at weekends!
why: 真多 is an exclamation of surprise, and 啊 carries the feeling. 吗 would ask whether it is crowded.

s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng tī qiú le tài lèi le
zh: 我不想踢球了，太累了。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng tī qiú le tài lèi le
en: I don't want to play football any more; I'm too tired.
why: 不...了 means 'not any more'. The second 了 in 太累了 is the usual pattern, so both are correct.

q: 你昨天一定看了那场比赛___？
zh: 你昨天一定看了那场比赛吧？
py: nǐ zuó tiān yī dìng kàn le nà chǎng bǐ sài ba
en: You must have watched that match yesterday, right?
why: 一定 shows the speaker is sure and just wants agreement, which is 吧. 吗 would suggest the speaker does not know.

q: 我们才跑了两公里___，还能再跑一会儿。
zh: 我们才跑了两公里呢，还能再跑一会儿。
py: wǒ men cái pǎo le liǎng gōng lǐ ne hái néng zài pǎo yī huì er
en: We've only run two kilometres; we can run a bit more.
why: 才 marks a small amount and 呢 stresses that we are still far from tired or done. 了 or 吗 would not carry that 'only' tone.

q: 地图上说这条街还在修路___，我们得绕过去。
zh: 地图上说这条街还在修路呢，我们得绕过去。
py: dì tú shàng shuō zhè tiáo jiē hái zài xiū lù ne wǒ men de rào guò qù
en: The map says this street is still being repaired, so we have to go around.
why: 还在 + verb says the roadwork has not finished, which 呢 expresses. 了 would announce a change, the opposite of 还.

q: 地铁站离这儿很远，我们还是打车去___。
zh: 地铁站离这儿很远，我们还是打车去吧。
py: dì tiě zhàn lí zhè r hěn yuǎn wǒ men hái shì dǎ chē qù ba
en: The subway station is far from here; we'd better take a taxi.
why: 还是 + action + 吧 gives a gentle recommendation after weighing options. 吗 would ask whether we take a taxi, and 呢 does not suggest.

s: 好吧，我跟你一起去看比赛。
s_py: hǎo ba wǒ gēn nǐ yì qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
zh: 好吧，我跟你一起去看比赛。
py: hǎo ba wǒ gēn nǐ yì qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
en: All right then, I'll go with you to watch the match.
why: 好吧 means 'all right then', giving in. It looks like 好 + 吧 as a question but is a fixed response.

q: 你是坐地铁去还是打车去___？
zh: 你是坐地铁去还是打车去？
py: nǐ shì zuò dì tiě qù hái shì dǎ chē qù
en: Are you going by subway or taking a taxi?
why: 还是 asks the listener to choose between two options, so the sentence is already a question and takes no 吗.

q: 天气很好，我们去公园跑步___。
zh: 天气很好，我们去公园跑步吧。
py: tiān qì hěn hǎo wǒ men qù gōng yuán pǎo bù ba
en: The weather is nice; let's go running in the park.
why: A proposal for both speakers to do something takes 吧. 吗 would only ask a question and 呢 does not suggest anything.

q: 这家店的人太多了，我们去对面那家___。
zh: 这家店的人太多了，我们去对面那家吧。
py: zhè jiā diàn de rén tài duō le wǒ men qù duì miàn nà jiā ba
en: This place is too crowded; let's go to the one across the street.
why: The speaker proposes an alternative, so 吧. 吗 would ask which shop we go to, and 的 does not fit a proposal.

task: Say it is no longer true.
zh: 我不喜欢跑步了。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huān pǎo bù le
en: I don't like running any more.
why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'not any more', a change from before. Without 了 it is just 'I don't like running'.

q: 我还没到十字路口___，你先别挂电话。
zh: 我还没到十字路口呢，你先别挂电话。
py: wǒ hái méi dào shí zì lù kǒu ne nǐ xiān bié guà diàn huà
en: I haven't reached the crossroads yet; don't hang up.
why: 还没 + 呢 says the situation is unchanged. 了 contradicts 没, and 吗 would ask whether I have arrived.

q: 既然大家都想去爬山，那就这个周末出发___。
zh: 既然大家都想去爬山，那就这个周末出发吧。
py: jì rán dà jiā dōu xiǎng qù pá shān nà jiù zhè ge zhōu mò chū fā ba
en: Since everyone wants to go hiking, let's set off this weekend.
why: The speaker settles the group's plan as a proposal, which is 吧. 吗 would reopen the question and 的 is not used for plans.

q: 这座城市的夜景多漂亮___！
zh: 这座城市的夜景多漂亮啊！
py: zhè zuò chéng shì de yè jǐng duō piào liàng a
en: How beautiful the night view of this city is!
why: 多 + adjective + 啊 is the standard exclamation. 吗 would ask about the view, and 了 would claim the view has changed.

q: 自从搬到市中心以后，我就不开车上班___。
zh: 自从搬到市中心以后，我就不开车上班了。
py: zì cóng bān dào shì zhōng xīn yǐ hòu wǒ jiù bù kāi chē shàng bān le
en: Since moving downtown I don't drive to work any more.
why: 自从...以后 contrasts now with before, so 不...了 'not any more'. 的 would turn it into a promise and 吗 would ask a question.

q: 这条街现在不通车___，你得走路过去。
zh: 这条街现在不通车了，你得走路过去。
py: zhè tiáo jiē xiàn zài bù tōng chē le nǐ de zǒu lù guò qù
en: This street is closed to traffic now, so you'll have to walk over.
why: 现在 + 不 + verb + 了 marks a change from open to closed. 吗 would ask a question, and 的 would be an assurance about the future.

q: 你先坐下来休息一下___。
zh: 你先坐下来休息一下吧。
py: nǐ xiān zuò xià lái xiū xī yī xià ba
en: Why don't you sit down and rest a bit first?
why: 吧 softens an instruction into a friendly suggestion. 吗 would ask whether you are resting, and 的 does not fit a command.

q: 如果周末不下雨，你愿意跟我们一起去骑车___？
zh: 如果周末不下雨，你愿意跟我们一起去骑车吗？
py: rú guǒ zhōu mò bù xià yǔ nǐ yuàn yì gēn wǒ men yì qǐ qù qí chē ma
en: If it doesn't rain at the weekend, would you like to go cycling with us?
why: This is an open invitation-question asking whether the listener is willing, so 吗. 嘛 states the obvious and never asks, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

q: 他大概不会来___。
zh: 他大概不会来吧。
py: tā dà gài bú huì lái ba
en: He probably won't come, I suppose.
why: 大概 marks a guess, and 吧 softens the statement as 'I suppose'. 吗 would ask a neutral question that conflicts with 大概.

s_py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ r ma
zh: 你想去哪儿？
py: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ r
en: Where do you want to go?
why: 哪儿 already makes this a question, so 吗 cannot be added. Only a statement can take 吗.

q: 我早就说过这条路不近___。
zh: 我早就说过这条路不近嘛。
py: wǒ zǎo jiù shuō guò zhè tiáo lù bù jìn ma
en: I told you long ago this road isn't short.
why: 嘛 reminds the listener of something already said, with 'I told you so'. 吗 would ask whether I said it.

q: 你周末去不去踢足球___？
zh: 你周末去不去踢足球？
py: nǐ zhōu mò qù bù qù tī zú qiú
en: Are you going to play football at the weekend or not?
why: 去不去 is the question, so 吗 would double it. Use verb-不-verb or 吗, never both.

q: 这附近有银行___？
zh: 这附近有银行吗？
py: zhè fù jìn yǒu yín háng ma
en: Is there a bank near here?
why: A neutral yes/no question about whether something exists takes 吗. 呢 would only fit with a noun alone, as in 银行呢?

q: 我的球拍___？
zh: 我的球拍呢？
py: wǒ de qiú pāi ne
en: Where's my racket?
why: A bare noun + 呢 asks where it is. 吗 cannot follow a bare noun, and 了 would not ask anything.

q: 现在才五点___，不用急。
zh: 现在才五点呢，不用急。
py: xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn ne bù yòng jí
en: It's only five o'clock now; no need to hurry.
why: 才 + time + 呢 stresses 'only' and that things are still early. 了 would say it has become five, which contradicts 才.

q: 我答应你，今年夏天一定会教你游泳___。
zh: 我答应你，今年夏天一定会教你游泳的。
py: wǒ dā yìng nǐ jīn nián xià tiān yī dìng huì jiào nǐ yóu yǒng de
en: I promise you, I will definitely teach you to swim this summer.
why: 答应 plus 一定会...的 is a solemn promise. 吧 would turn it into a weak guess and 吗 would ask whether I will.

q: 他是新手___，打不好很正常。
zh: 他是新手嘛，打不好很正常。
py: tā shì xīn shǒu ma dǎ bù hǎo hěn zhèng cháng
en: He's a beginner, after all; it's normal for him not to play well.
why: 嘛 says 'after all', giving the obvious reason. 吗 would ask 'Is he a beginner?' and does not fit before a continuing comment.

zh: 外面的路灯都亮了。
py: wài miàn de lù dēng dōu liàng le
en: The street lamps outside have all come on.
why: 了 closes the sentence to mark the change, and 都 goes before the verb 亮.

q: 他为什么今天没来踢球___？
zh: 他为什么今天没来踢球呢？
py: tā wèi shén me jīn tiān méi lái tī qiú ne
en: Why didn't he come to play football today, I wonder?
why: 为什么 already asks the question, and 呢 only softens it. 吗 can never follow a question word, and 吧 would turn it into a guess.

q: 这么晚了，商店应该都关门了___？
zh: 这么晚了，商店应该都关门了吧？
py: zhè me wǎn le shāng diàn yīng gāi dōu guān mén le ba
en: It's so late; the shops must all be closed, I take it?
why: 应该 shows an assumption the speaker wants confirmed, so 吧. 吗 does not combine with 应该, because it signals no opinion at all.

q: 前面堵车了，我们走小路___。
zh: 前面堵车了，我们走小路吧。
py: qián miàn dǔ chē le wǒ men zǒu xiǎo lù ba
en: There's a traffic jam ahead; let's take the side road.
why: The speaker is proposing a new route, so 吧. 吗 would ask whether we are taking it, and 呢 would not propose anything.
